clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Covers dimension, quality and strength requirement of lime based blocks (both hollow and solid) used for walls, internal partitions and filler walls.

clauses.title: General Requirements
clauses.text: 2. General Requirements— All blocks shall be sound, free from cracks, broken edges, distortion and other defects. The bedding surface shall be at right angles to the face of blocks. The ends of the blocks which form the vertical joints may be  plain, tongued and gooved or double grooved.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 3. Types Type A - Block with both faces keyed for plastering Type B - Block with both faces  smooth and suitable for use without plasterning or rendering on either side,and. Type C - Block with one face keyed and one face smooth.

clauses.title: Actual
clauses.text: 4.1    Actual  Sizes Length 390 mm Width 90,190, 290 mm Height 90, 190 mm SUMMARY OF IS 3115 : 1992 LIME BASED BLOCKS (Second  Revision) Note —  For methods of test, refer to IS 2185 (Part 1):1979 Concrete masonry units— Part 1 solid  and hollow concrete blocks (second revision). For detailed information, refer to IS 3115:1992 Specification for lime based blocks (second revision ).

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 4.2     Tolerances— Length ± 5 mm, Max Width and Height ± 3 mm, Max

clauses.title: Hallow block shall be made
clauses.text: 4.3  Hallow block shall be made  with one or more cavities and wall thickness at any point shall not  be less than 40 mm.

clauses.title: Block Density
clauses.text: 5.1 Block Density — Shall not be less than 1 000 kg/m3

clauses.title: Compressive Strength
clauses.text: 5.2 Compressive Strength — Average strength  of eight blocks shall be not less than 3.5 MPa. Also compressive strength of any individual block shall not fall below the minimum average value by more than 20 percent.

clauses.title: Drying Shrinkage
clauses.text: 5.3 Drying Shrinkage— Shall not exceed 0.1 percent

clauses.title: Moisture Movement
clauses.text: 5.4 Moisture Movement— Shall not exceed 0.05 percent.
